reason: ADR-0250 §14 M3 turns the two built-in cloud document providers into modules (lib/google-docs/module.ts, lib/lark-docs/module.ts), each adding one member to the `docs-provider` collection port; the kernel keeps the framework in lib/docs-providers/ and the port's contract (types/modules/ports/docs-provider.ts). The module count rises by two because vendor implementations left a kernel subsystem, which is the direction §14 asks for, not debt. Nothing is owed back; phase 2 is named because it re-baselines the size measures once the transitional table is empty.
